meta.name: ValveOS parts-knowledge database
meta.purpose: Config-agnostic engineering knowledge keyed to the PART (partId / item sub-code), never to a step or a single manual. Configs/manuals reference partIds and pull tool/torque/check content from here at render time.
meta.primaryKey: partId (matches the STEPS id in app/src/App.jsx); Rajdeep item sub-code stored as itemSubCode
meta.resolutionOrder: part -> relationship -> interfaceRule -> categoryDefault (most specific wins)
meta.safetyRule: Never fabricate a torque, fastener size, or spec. Unconfirmed values are null with confidence 'placeholder' or 'unknown' and listed in openQuestions.
meta.canonicalHome: This file is edited only from the parts-knowledge command chat.

authoritativeSources.componentList: docs/Datasheets/VAC Standard Component List .xlsx - RIPPL code / model / make are the ONLY absolutely-true columns; all else grain-of-salt.
authoritativeSources.stepFiles: POLICY (Arnav 2026-07-21): the official OEM STEP files in 'Dirac x VAC/Component STEP files/' are the ONLY source of truth for component geometry, configs, and 3D. The generic TraceParts/GrabCAD stand-ins used for Config 1 & 2 are DEPRECATED - they must be fully replaced by official STEP-derived .glb as each manufacturer's STEP arrives. No generic stand-ins remain in the final product.

geometryStatus.policy: official OEM STEP -> FreeCAD/cascadio -> .glb; swap into app per component as STEPs arrive.
haveOfficialStep: afr (FR1001, Shavo SB10 - converted to afr_real.glb, live in app; seat via editor)
geometryStatus.note: App currently runs on generic stand-ins (acceptable for the Wizard-of-Oz demo); real-geometry swap is a quality upgrade, per-component, as official STEPs come in.

catalogIngested.note: Every stocked RIPPL code seeded as a catalog skeleton (code/model/make only). status='catalog' until a config uses it, then it graduates to 'active' and gets datasheet-enriched.

rules.text: Valve is NOT split for automation; only the lever handle and nameplate are removed.
rules.why: Automation only needs the stem; splitting the body is unnecessary and risks the seat.

rules.text: Retain the nameplate; it is re-tied to the finished unit for tagging.
rules.why: Spec traceability on the shipped assembly.

rules.text: Note ball position (closed) before removing the lever.
rules.why: Preserves reference for fail-action orientation later.
rules.failureMode: Actuator fitted to wrong open/close datum.

rules.text: Materials (component list): body ASTM A216 WCB, stem ASTM A479 Type 316, trim CF8M/F316, seat PTFE; design ISO 17292; ends flanged ASME B16.5 #150.
rules.why: Confirmed construction for the BV1121 valve.
rules.source: VAC Standard Component List (RIPPL code / model / make = authoritative)

checks.acceptance: Full open-to-close by hand, no binding.

checks.text: Clamped square in vice, bore horizontal.
checks.acceptance: Flange faces to the line, valve not skewed.

provenance.overallConfidence: CORRECTED from component list: model is L1FF1C-015mm (FULL bore), not L1RF1C (regular bore). ISO 5211 F03 read off the regular-bore catalogue table - re-confirm for full bore. Materials/design confirmed.

lever.displayName: Valve lever / hand-operating handle (removed during automation)

rules.text: Removed during automation: only the lever and nameplate come off (the valve is not split). Keep the nameplate; refit the stem nut.
rules.why: The actuator replaces manual operation; the nameplate is reused for final tagging.
rules.failureMode: Lost nameplate; stem nut left off.

rules.text: Note the ball position (closed) before removing the lever.
rules.why: Preserves the datum for fail-action orientation.
rules.failureMode: Actuator fitted to the wrong open/close datum.

checks.text: Nameplate retained; ball position noted; stem nut refitted.
checks.acceptance: Nameplate set aside; stem nut back on.

provenance.overallConfidence: removal step confirmed; the lever .glb is a generated placeholder (swap real CAD later)

interfaces.size: valve top is ISO 5211 F03 (M5); Rajdeep bracket mounts to stop-plate ears (2x M6 per golden A3)

fasteners.source: video ground-truth + golden-steplist A3 (2 screws confirmed; size/torque placeholder)

rules.text: Bracket goes onto the VALVE first, right after the lever is removed.
rules.why: Establishes the mounting datum before the actuator is dressed and lowered.
rules.failureMode: Rework if actuator is built up before bracket is referenced.

rules.text: Bracket must sit flat with no rock.
rules.why: A rocking bracket misaligns the actuator to the stem.

checks.text: Bracket flat on the valve pad, no rock.
checks.acceptance: No gap or rocking under hand pressure.

checks.text: ISO 5211 hole pattern up and aligned.
checks.acceptance: Actuator base holes line up without forcing.

provenance.overallConfidence: custom part; actuator-side mount = F05/M6 confirmed (Arnav). Valve-side screw size/torque still open (OQ-02).

rules.text: Coupling seats on the valve stem flats, square tang up.
rules.why: Correct orientation for the actuator pinion to engage.
rules.failureMode: Actuator will not drop / drive not transmitted.

checks.acceptance: Fully down on the flats, not perched on the stem tip.
Tang square and clean for pinion entry.

provenance.overallConfidence: identity confirmed; stem/pinion dimensions unknown

actuator.displayName: Pneumatic actuator, rack & pinion, spring return (fail-to-close / spring-to-close)

oem.datasheetRef: docs/Datasheets/Valmet Actuator Catalogue.pdf (IMO-218EN, 5/2022); VAC Standard Component List (RIPPL code / model / make = authoritative)

interfaces.role: valve mount (base). Offers dual F03/F05; Rajdeep uses F05 (M6) to the bracket [Arnav 2026-07-17]

interfaces.source: Valmet catalogue p25 (N A/F=14) + p28 (shaft-key type D)
Valmet catalogue p25 (M5x8 deep; port T=1/4")

interfaces.role: accessory mount (top, for limit switch box)

fasteners.source: size confirmed M6/F05 by Arnav 2026-07-17; torque not in Valmet catalogue (set per bolt grade / Rajdeep standard)
Valmet catalogue p16 tightening-torque table (RNP40-80 = M6, 8 Nm)
fasteners.confidence: confirmed (internal service torque; NOT the valve-mount torque)

rules.text: Remove the top cap / position indicator and wipe clean before fitting the limit switch box.
rules.why: Exposes the ISO 5211 pinion drive for the LSB shaft.

rules.text: SR40 = 4.0 barg spring version (matches AFR set 4 bar). Action code C = spring-to-CLOSE, so the package is FAIL-CLOSE: the valve closes on loss of air. Confirmed by Arnav 2026-07-16. Air supply must meet the spring rating and must not exceed 8 barg (max supply); design pressure 10 barg.
rules.why: The spring is sized for 4.0 bar; under-supply will not complete the stroke, over-supply beyond 8 bar risks the pressure-retaining parts.
rules.source: Valmet catalogue p4 (pressures) + p28 (order code C) + Arnav 2026-07-16

rules.text: Confirm FAIL-TO-CLOSE (spring-to-close) orientation before final torque: the valve must go CLOSED on air loss.
rules.why: Wrong orientation reverses the fail-action of the whole package.
rules.failureMode: Valve fails to the wrong position on air loss (safety).

checks.text: Actuator square to the valve before final torque.
checks.acceptance: No skew; base fully seated on bracket.
Pinion drives the stem through full travel.

hookups.detail: Operating media air/nitrogen. SR40 spring rated 4.0 barg (matches AFR set 4 bar). Max supply 8 barg, design 10 barg. Output torque RNP50-SR40 at 4 bar = 9-13 Nm (min-max over stroke). IP66/67, -20..+80 C (temp code G). Source: Valmet catalogue p4, p5. | Component list: full code RNP50SR40CA1GD, pneumatic connection 1/4" NPT, working supply max 6.5 bar(g). Code 'C' = spring-to-close (fail-close), consistent with the fail-action decision.

provenance.overallConfidence: Model RNP50SR40CA1GD confirmed (component list). OEM-confirmed (Valmet catalogue): pressures, spring rating, ISO 5211 flanges F03/F05, 14 mm bi-square drive, NAMUR M5. Fail-action = FAIL-CLOSE (spring-to-close, code C) confirmed by Arnav 2026-07-16. Open: valve-mount torque; F-code resolved: actuator uses F05/M6 to bracket, valve is F03 (Arnav 2026-07-17).

interfaces.size: NAMUR (2x M5 from actuator face); 1/4" air ports

rules.text: Select 3/2 or 5/2 per customer and set the O-ring gate to the required port before mounting.
rules.why: The same SOV body serves multiple functions; the gate sets the airflow path.
rules.failureMode: Actuator strokes the wrong way or not at all.

rules.text: Fit the rubber NAMUR plate with 2 O-rings; peel the protective film first.
rules.why: Seals the NAMUR interface; film left on prevents a seal.
rules.failureMode: Air leak at the actuator face.

rules.text: Blank all air holes except the middle (supply); fit the silencer/exhaust so it points clear.
rules.why: Only the supply port should be open; exhaust must vent freely.
rules.failureMode: Cross-porting or blocked exhaust; erratic stroke.

rules.text: 3/2 normally-closed direct-acting NAMUR SOV; on de-energise/air-fail it returns (spring). Match the O-ring gate to the ordered function before mounting.
rules.why: Sets the fail behaviour and airflow path.
rules.failureMode: Actuator strokes wrong or not at all.

checks.text: Gate matches the ordered function (3/2 vs 5/2).
O-rings seated and compressed evenly; supply hole open; exhaust clear.
checks.acceptance: No visible gap; supply port open, exhaust unobstructed.

hookups.detail: 3/2 direct-acting NAMUR solenoid, normally closed. Operating pressure 0-10 bar. Ports 1/4" (BSP or NPT). Direct-mount to the actuator NAMUR face. Source: Rotex 30318 datasheet.

24 VDC coil; cable entry 1/2" NPT. Enclosure per suffix: -16 = weatherproof IP66/IP67 (component-list standard SV1005); -37 = FLAMEPROOF Ex d IIC T4/T6 IP67 (DB's SV1007). Confirm which applies to Config 1 (OQ-16). Source: Rotex 30318 datasheet.

provenance.overallConfidence: Rotex 30318 datasheet confirmed: 3/2 NC NAMUR, 24VDC, 0-10 bar, 1/4" ports, 1/2" NPT cable entry. CODE/CERT open (OQ-16): weatherproof -16 (SV1005) vs flameproof -37 (SV1007).

afr.displayName: Air filter regulator (FRL), 1/4" BSP, with dial gauge

oem.datasheetRef: docs/Datasheets/AFR_ SB-10.pdf; VAC Standard Component List

rules.text: Bowl / drain points down; mounting slots vertical for height adjustment.
rules.why: Bowl drains correctly; vertical slots let the AFR height line up with the air train.
rules.failureMode: Bowl won't drain; tube run won't align.

rules.text: Thread the dial gauge into the gauge port with PTFE on the thread; gauge readable from the front.
rules.why: Sealed, readable pressure indication.
rules.failureMode: Leak at the gauge port; unreadable gauge.

rules.text: Set regulator to 4 bar for this build.
rules.why: Config 1 set pressure.

rules.text: PC (polycarbonate) bowl limits: max inlet 10.5 bar, max ambient 50 C. Regulator is the relieving type.
rules.why: Operating envelope for the AFR bowl.

checks.text: Bowl down, gauge readable, set pressure 4 bar.
checks.acceptance: Gauge reads 4 bar with supply on.

hookups.detail: Ports G 1/4 BSP parallel (F). Filter element 25 micron; transparent polycarbonate bowl; manual drain; RELIEVING regulator. Regulated spring range 10-100 psi (0.70-7.0 bar) - Config 1 set 4 bar. Max inlet 10.5 bar (PC bowl); max ambient 50 C (PC bowl). Flow at 1/4" ~19 scfm, Cv 0.35. Source: Shavo SB10 datasheet + component list.

lsb.displayName: Limit switch box (2x SPDT) with integral mounting bracket

oem.datasheetRef: docs/Datasheets/K-Series-Bulletin S100-1EN-NELES.pdf; VAC Standard Component List

interfaces.role: mounts directly on the actuator top; unit shaft couples to the actuator (NAMUR) shaft

fasteners.role: integral bracket feet to actuator top

rules.text: The LSB ships with its mounting bracket integral (the '+BKT' in KS2V1A2NGRNN+BKT). There is NO separate riser bracket; the box and bracket mount as ONE unit directly onto the actuator top.
rules.why: The bracket is welded/bolted to the box base and the drive shaft protrudes through it, ready to drop onto the actuator.
rules.failureMode: Modeling or ordering a separate riser that does not exist.

rules.text: Engage the LSB shaft in the pinion adapter BEFORE the nuts are pulled tight.
rules.why: Pulling nuts first prevents the shaft from seating, or shears/bends it.
rules.failureMode: Broken or disengaged shaft; no position feedback.

rules.text: Set cams to OPEN / CLOSED (round-2 test step, knowledge lives with the part).
rules.why: Cams define the switch trip points.

rules.text: Model coding: KS = K-series STANDARD housing, KC = K-series COMPACT housing; the '2' = two switch elements. Set the cams to the open/closed limits after mounting.
rules.why: KS vs KC is only the housing; both carry 2 switches here.

checks.acceptance: Switches trip at true end positions; dome indicator reads correctly.

checks.text: Integral bracket seated square on the actuator top (VDI/VDE 3845).
checks.acceptance: Both bracket feet flat, shaft engaged in pinion before final tightening.

hookups.detail: 2x SPDT mechanical switches (Honeywell V15S05-CZ100A05-01 per component list); IP67; housing epoxy powder-coated die-cast aluminium (LM6); cable entry 1/2" NPT (2 entries); temp -20 to +80 C general. Adjustable colour-coded cams; 90-deg open/closed visual indicator on the dome. Source: Neles K-series bulletin.

provenance.overallConfidence: Neles K-series confirmed: VDI/VDE 3845 + NAMUR shaft, IP67, 2x SPDT Honeywell V15, 1/2" NPT entry, die-cast alu housing, +BKT integral bracket. CODE open (OQ-17): KS2V (standard housing, DB LB1002) vs KC2V (compact housing, list LB1001).

rules.text: Bracket fits over the stem onto the valve stop-plate ears.
rules.why: Locates the bracket to the valve's mounting datum.

checks.text: Bracket flat, no rock; ISO 5211 pattern up.

relationships.interfaceStandard: actuator pinion drive (ISO 5211 bi-square, 14 mm A/F)

rules.text: Rotate the coupling to align the tang to the pinion; never force it.
rules.why: Forcing damages the pinion or shears the tang.

rules.text: Actuator drive is a 14 mm A/F ISO 5211 bi-square female socket; the coupling must present a matching 14 mm bi-square to the actuator.
rules.why: Correct drive size for torque transmission.

checks.text: Coupling tang aligned to pinion before the actuator seats.
checks.acceptance: Actuator drops on without forcing; drives through full travel.

rules.text: Engage the LSB shaft in the pinion adapter BEFORE the mounting nuts are pulled tight.
rules.why: Nuts-first stops the shaft seating or bends it.

fasteners.role: LSB integral bracket feet to actuator top

checks.text: Shaft engaged, integral bracket square, cams readable.

relationships.source: golden-steplist-config01.md B2 (LSB mounts directly via its integral bracket; no separate riser)

rules.text: Compress the O-rings evenly; keep the supply hole open and exhaust clear.
rules.why: Even seal + correct porting for clean stroke.

rules.text: Actuator NAMUR face: 2x M5 tapped holes and a 1/4" air port; SOV bolts are M5.
rules.why: Confirms SOV mounting fastener size.

checks.text: O-rings compressed evenly; supply open; exhaust clear.
checks.acceptance: No leak at NAMUR face on air-on.

rules.text: AFR 'in' open (supply), elbow on 'out'; bent metal pipe runs from AFR to the SOV middle (supply) hole.
rules.why: Feeds regulated air to the SOV.

checks.text: Pipe geometry matches AFR height; nuts not cross-threaded.
checks.acceptance: Leak-free run; AFR height lines up with the tube.

interfaceRules.source: standard (flange size + bolt pattern to be tabulated per F0x code)

interfaceRules.appliesTo: accessory (LSB / positioner) mount on actuator top
interfaceRules.source: standard (mounting pattern fixed; fasteners to confirm)

rules.text: Remove the position indicator / top cap before fitting top-mounted accessories.
Confirm fail-action (fail-open vs fail-close) orientation before final torque.
Peel protective film and seat O-rings before mounting; blank unused ports.

openQuestions.question: Valve-to-bracket screw size and torque (2x socket-head)?
Actuator valve-mount bolt TORQUE. Size CONFIRMED M6 (F05) [Arnav 2026-07-17]; torque not in the Valmet catalogue - set per M6 bolt grade (e.g. 8.8) or Rajdeep standard.
Riser stud size and nut torque (4x M5 placeholder)?
SOV NAMUR mount bolt TORQUE. Size confirmed M5 (Valmet p25); torque low per NAMUR - confirm value.

AFR mounting fasteners: the Shavo bracket is optional/panel-mount; Config 1 mounts the AFR on a Rajdeep custom L-plate (afr-plate). Confirm the AFR-to-L-plate and L-plate-to-actuator fastener sizes/torques from the Rajdeep drawing.
Actual tool sizes (Allen key mm, spanner mm) used on the real build; golden list values are placeholders.

Coupling: actuator drive confirmed = 14 mm A/F ISO 5211 bi-square (Valmet). Valve STEM square/flat size is NOT in the L&T catalogue dimension tables - get it from the valve GA drawing (drawings/15mm-...pdf) or L&T on request.

Config 1 is now FAIL-CLOSE. Config 2 was defined as the fail-to-close 'opposite' of Config 1, so the contrast is broken (both fail-close); Config 2's own actuator code RNP80SR40C... is also spring-to-close (C). Decide: flip Config 2 to FAIL-OPEN (code A) to keep a two-config contrast, or accept both fail-close and drop the 'opposite' framing. Affects data/config02.json, docs/config02-ingestion.md, PROJECT-STATUS Config 2 section, and App.jsx toConfig2.
QTM-250 gearbox datasheet needed: gear ratio, rated output torque, mounting standard (ISO 5211 flange size?), and IP/temp rating.
openQuestions.blocks: any spec use for the MOR

openQuestions.question: Is the 11x11 mm square the INPUT drive or the valve-stem OUTPUT? Confirm from GA drawing.
Which config(s) use the MOR, and does it mount between valve and actuator, or as a standalone manual operator? Confirm item sub-code.

SOV code + hazardous-area cert: DB uses SV1007 = 30318-...-24VDC-37 (FLAMEPROOF Ex d); the VAC component list standard is SV1005 = 30318-...-24VDC-16 (WEATHERPROOF). Same 3/2 24VDC 30318, different enclosure/cert. Confirm which is Config 1's standard (affects certification, not geometry).

LSB code/housing: DB uses LB1002 = KS2V1A2NGRNN (KS = STANDARD housing); the VAC component list has LB1001 = KC2V1A3NGRNN+BKT (KC = COMPACT housing). Both are 2-switch NAMUR/VDI-VDE-3845 units - the difference is the housing type. Confirm which is Config 1's standard.
